description: Government-issued photo identity card (driver's license, state ID, or national identity card) establishing legal holder name, residential address, document number, issuing authority, and expiration date. Where to read: Identified by state/national seal, portrait photograph, AAMVA numbered fields (1, 2, 4b, 4d, 8), and machine-readable zone. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with a utility billing statement (`utility-bill`) or employer badge lacking government statutory authority.

name.description: Full legal name of the credential holder normalized as First Last. Where to read: AAMVA fields 1 (family name) and 2 (given names) next to the portrait. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the state governor or DMV commissioner signature name.

address.description: Holder's primary residential street address printed on the credential face. Where to read: AAMVA field 8 directly below the holder's name. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the issuing agency's capitol city header.

doc_number.description: Unique alphanumeric credential number assigned by the issuing authority. Where to read: AAMVA field 4d ('DL', 'ID', or 'LIC#'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the document discriminator (DD / field 5) or donor/class codes.

issuing_authority.description: Government jurisdiction or agency that issued the credential. Where to read: Top banner header and state/national seal. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the holder's city of residence as the issuing authority.

expiry.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the identity document expires. Where to read: AAMVA field 4b ('EXP'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract Date of Birth ('DOB' / field 3) or Issue Date ('ISS' / field 4a).
